full_judgment: 3. On appeal by the respondents being Administrative Tribunal Appeal Nos.134, 139, 143 and 144 of 2009, the Administrative Appellate Tribunal disposed all the appeals analogously and by its judgment and order dated 12th April, 2010 allowed the appeals, declared the Notification dated 3rd September, 2007 terminating respondents as illegal and directed the Election Commission to reinstate them to their respective service by giving them suitable assignment forthwith.
